summary: Fixed AsyncStorage crash caused by incompatible @react-native-async-storage/async-storage v3.1.0. Downgraded to Expo SDK 56 compatible v2.2.0 via npx expo install. Added readSavedIds/writeSavedIds helpers with try/catch in saved-offers-context.tsx so storage failures degrade to in-memory state instead of uncaught promise rejections.
current_status: Bottom tab navigation is implemented. AsyncStorage dependency is now pinned to 2.2.0 for Expo compatibility. User should restart Expo with cache clear (npx expo start -c) for the native module change to take effect.
